description: Answer or update the sender on a message by its id. state: 'working' when you start (call again to say you are still on it; Pulsar redelivers it if you go quiet for 30 minutes), 'reply' to answer in its thread (text required), 'done' when finished (text, if given, goes to the sender as your answer), 'declined' if you can't do it (text: the reason; retry=true to get it again later).

message_id.description: The id shown on the message, e.g. m_...

priority.description: urgent: lands mid-turn. normal (default): next turn, wakes an idle agent. fyi: no wake, waits in the inbox.

retry.description: declined only: deliver it to you again later.

text.description: reply: the answer. done: optional short outcome. declined: the reason.

name: respond
title: Respond to a message
